podcast.body: Sigue Sigue Sputnik built their entire career on selling out as an art form, with music secondary to hype, image, and money-making. They signed to EMI without even submitting a demo tape — only a video of science fiction film clips. Their main slogan was "Fleece the World." Before the album's release they auctioned advertising space between the tracks, with studio line from L'Oréal and *ID* magazine buying space on the external artwork and commercials embedded within the record itself. Several band members had almost zero musical ability. The album underperformed and the band broke up after their second release. "With the way the music industry is going these days, maybe they were just ahead of their time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
